about: A map whose value is a map (docs/adr/0108, D12): the empty inner map put at a key with no value, then written through the place `slots[1]`; a put, a remove, `len`, `has` and a read through that place; the inner map full, answered as its own outcome; a walk of the inner map; a write through a key that is absent, which raises error.execution, ends its block and creates nothing; the inner map taken whole into a variable of its type, which a key that is absent fails before the variable is written; and a walk of the outer map whose body asks has and len of each inner map it binds. A map is stated as the array of its entries, each [key, value], the inner map as its own array. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: region 2 is absent: the put through it fails before anything is written, and the block ends before `after` counts it
a put that names no value of a map whose value is a map puts the empty one
the inner map holds its two: the third slot is refused as its outcome, and nothing is raised
a slot the inner map holds takes the new amount where it stands
the inner map at region 1 is taken whole into a variable of exactly its type
a walk of the outer map binds each inner map where it is held, and asks has and len of it
region 2 is absent: the take fails, error.execution is raised and the block ends before `region` or `taken` is written
slot 20 is gone: the read of it fails, error.execution is raised and the block ends before `after` counts it
region 2 is still absent, and the put through it creates nothing
a put that names no value at a key the map holds replaces its value with the empty one where it stands
the inner map was emptied where it stands: no region holds slot 20, and none holds a slot
